messages:
praveen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw a recurring pattern where canary rollouts with feature flags hit perf/error thresholds but auto-rollback didn't always trigger. Need owners + dates for remediation.

anna: I can own auto-rollback reliability. Plan: tighten detection thresholds, add integration tests, and add a synthetic canary smoke test. ETA: EOW for initial PR.

devon: I'll take blast-radius / flag targeting work. Prototype a safer audience gating and staged shard rules. Will aim to have a gating RFC + prototype by Wed.

lina: I'll handle dashboards/alerts — missing traces made it hard to triage. Will add p50/p95 token-level traces and an "active canary" view. Need owners for perf test infra.

carter: Proposing a simple rollback-safety circuit combining latency + error signals. Draft rule:
```
if error_rate > 0.5% || p95_latency > 800ms -> trigger rollback
```
I'll put up a prototype PR that wires this into the rollout controller.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-314 — linked to postmortem. Assigned watchers: @praveen @anna.

praveen: Thanks. Adding specific action items to the follow-up sheet now. Current plan: 
- Anna: auto-rollback signal + integration tests (due 2026-04-02)
- Devon: flag targeting + default audience guard (<=1% default) (due 2026-03-31)
- Lina: dashboards, traces, alert rules (due 2026-03-28)
- Carter: rollback-safety circuit PR + tests (due 2026-04-05)

anna: I'll also add unit tests for the rollback signal generator and a canary harness smoke test that runs on every deploy to the canary pool.

devon: One ask — can we make the new flag create flow require a "max_audience_pct" param and default to 1%? That would prevent the usual slip-ups.

praveen: +1. Make that part of Devon's deliverable.

lina: Quick question: infra approval needed for KV cache warmup change (affects cold-start p95). Who can sign off?

carter: I can review infra design, but we need eng-platform approval for deployment windows and smoke test windows.

praveen: I'll schedule a 30m alignment tomorrow at 10:00 to cover infra signoffs, test owners, and rollout windows. If you can't make it, drop updates in the follow-up doc.

anna: 👍

devon: noted

lina: will be there

carter: ok
